bv_chatgpt.name: Brand Visibility setup and baseline
bv_chatgpt.assumptions: An approved prompt plan and supported workspace are available. The log-forwarding job in the Client's CDN console is often the longest item; the partner confirms its date in week one and starts the strategy and prompt work before it is live. The prompt count is the service scope. Crawler access is requested once per site, here: Adobe's scanner (Spacecat/1.0, which Sites Optimizer also uses) and the AI crawlers in robots.txt and bot rules. The edge-optimization user agent is allowed by whichever service sets up the edge route.
firstTwoSentences: An approved prompt plan and supported workspace are available.
The log-forwarding job in the Client's CDN console is often the longest item; the partner confirms its date in week one and starts the strategy and prompt work before it is live.

bv_chatgpt.name: Prompt strategy and measurement plan
bv_chatgpt.assumptions: The Client provides business priorities, available search/customer evidence and named reviewers. Shared strategy work is reused across related domains. The agreed prompt count fits within the Client's Brand Visibility license.
firstTwoSentences: The Client provides business priorities, available search/customer evidence and named reviewers.
Shared strategy work is reused across related domains.

bv_chatgpt.name: Monthly prompt and performance review
bv_chatgpt.assumptions: A working baseline and existing analytics reports are available. Stable prompt cohorts support comparison. Additional domain or market coverage is explicitly scoped. Brand Visibility runs the tracked prompts, reports visibility and citations and lists opportunities on its own; these hours cover the judgment around it: which prompts to keep, add or retire, what the results mean for the Client, which actions come first, and the Client review. This is the one monthly readout. Where Sites Optimizer's monthly fixes are in scope, it includes their search results, and they produce no separate report. Edge fixes chosen here go live only where an edge route is in place; otherwise they are listed for a pilot or as change requests. Findings that need a change to the site itself go to Sites Optimizer's monthly fixes where those are in scope, and otherwise to the Client's web team.
firstTwoSentences: A working baseline and existing analytics reports are available.
Stable prompt cohorts support comparison.

bv_chatgpt.name: Content improvements for search and AI
bv_chatgpt.assumptions: The Client provides source facts, reviewers and publishing access. Brand Visibility's edge optimizations, such as LLM-friendly summaries, reach only the AI assistants Adobe supports (ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude) and leave the page unchanged; these hours cover the lasting page changes that people and every search engine see: briefs, writing with approved facts, review rounds and publishing.
firstTwoSentences: The Client provides source facts, reviewers and publishing access.

bc_accounts.name: Implement Brand Concierge
bc_accounts.assumptions:
The Client has licensed Brand Concierge and supplies the approved content, current product facts, reviewers and the handoff destination; compliance decisions stay with the Client.

The documented handoff is live chat or meeting booking through Adobe Marketo Qualifier (formerly Sales Qualifier), which needs the representatives added as users in the Adobe Admin Console and at least one representative with a connected calendar (for meeting booking) or set live chat availability (for live chat); a handoff to another chat or contact-center platform is not a documented route and is confirmed with Adobe first.

Live chat and meeting booking don't need Marketo Engage: round robin and direct-agent routing work without it, and it is needed only for custom routing rules, which pick a team by Marketo attributes, and for writing concierge activities to the Marketo person record. Live chat conversations are kept for 30 days, so the Client confirms its own record-keeping needs.

The baseline is the anonymous, public-information experience; profile-based answers are not assumed. Hours scale with the number of products, sources, journeys and test conversations.

These hours cover the partner's work around Adobe's setup: approved sources and reviewers, conversation and disclosure design, the handoff, the golden-answer and refusal tests and the staged rollout.

bank22_lines.name: Connect Brand Visibility and CJA measurement
bank22_lines.assumptions: The integration is available (Brand Visibility's AI-agent data reaches CJA as an Experience Platform dataset through the Adobe Brand Visibility source, which the Client adds to a CJA connection and data view; Adobe Analytics can feed only Brand Visibility's referral reporting on the Business Impact tab), the Client is on the paid Brand Visibility offer (trial workspaces cannot connect), the CJA integration is enabled for the organization, and CDN log forwarding is live, since the connection reads the CDN log summaries. Client application owners provide access and approve metric definitions. The Client has licensed CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate (derived fields are not included in CJA Foundation).
firstTwoSentences: The integration is available (Brand Visibility's AI-agent data reaches CJA as an Experience Platform dataset through the Adobe Brand Visibility source, which the Client adds to a CJA connection and data view; Adobe Analytics can feed only Brand Visibility's referral reporting on the Business Impact tab), the Client is on the paid Brand Visibility offer (trial workspaces cannot connect), the CJA integration is enabled for the organization, and CDN log forwarding is live, since the connection reads the CDN log summaries.
Client application owners provide access and approve metric definitions.

bank22_lines.name: Audiences that act on the data
bank22_lines.assumptions: The Client licenses Real-Time CDP or Journey Optimizer, because CJA audience publishing to Real-Time Customer Profile needs one of them; CJA alone does not license Profile Service. The Client has licensed CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate (derived fields are not included in CJA Foundation). A CJA administrator, who gets the Audience Publishing permission automatically, also has Experience Platform's Manage Profiles permission. The Person ID in the CJA connection is agreed: CJA sends it as each audience member's primary identity, one identity per person. Channel owners confirm identity, consent and the intended use, and take part. Any downstream destination is already configured and licensed in Experience Platform and is activated there after the audience is published. The source datasets don't need to be enabled for Profile. Audiences come from AI-referred visitors in the Client's existing web data, found with a derived field on AI referring domains; the Brand Visibility dataset holds only aggregate AI-agent activity by URL and host, with no personal identifiers, and is not needed for these audiences.
firstTwoSentences: The Client licenses Real-Time CDP or Journey Optimizer, because CJA audience publishing to Real-Time Customer Profile needs one of them; CJA alone does not license Profile Service.
The Client has licensed CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate (derived fields are not included in CJA Foundation).
